agent_runs_one_holder_per_project.name: agent_runs_one_holder_per_project
agent_runs_one_holder_per_project.where: "agent_runs"."started_at" is not null and "agent_runs"."status" not in ('succeeded', 'failed', 'cancelled')

checkpoints_turn_check.name: checkpoints_turn_check
checkpoints_turn_check.value: ("checkpoints"."kind" = 'turn') = ("checkpoints"."run_id" is not null and "checkpoints"."turn" is not null)

checkpoints_revert_check.name: checkpoints_revert_check
checkpoints_revert_check.value: ("checkpoints"."kind" = 'revert') = ("checkpoints"."actor_id" is not null and "checkpoints"."reverts_id" is not null)

checkpoints_pull_check.name: checkpoints_pull_check
checkpoints_pull_check.value: ("checkpoints"."kind"::text = 'pull') = ("checkpoints"."actor_id" is not null and "checkpoints"."sync_operation_id" is not null)

checkpoints_edit_shape.name: checkpoints_edit_shape
checkpoints_edit_shape.value: ("checkpoints"."kind"::text = 'edit') = ("checkpoints"."actor_id" is not null and "checkpoints"."run_id" is null and "checkpoints"."reverts_id" is null and "checkpoints"."sync_operation_id" is null)

connections_github_shape.name: connections_github_shape
connections_github_shape.value: "connections"."provider"::text <> 'github' or ("connections"."account_id" is not null and "connections"."installation_id" is not null and "connections"."account_type" is not null)

connector_resources_single_owner.name: connector_resources_single_owner
connector_resources_single_owner.value: ("connector_resources"."kind"::text = 'cloudflare_dns_record' and "connector_resources"."binding_id" is null) or ("connector_resources"."kind"::text <> 'cloudflare_dns_record' and "connector_resources"."domain_id" is null)

domains_failure_reason_check.name: domains_failure_reason_check
domains_failure_reason_check.value: ("domains"."state"::text <> 'failed' or "domains"."failure_reason" is not null) and ("domains"."state"::text not in ('pending', 'active', 'drifted', 'removed') or "domains"."failure_reason" is null)

domains_serving_proven_check.name: domains_serving_proven_check
domains_serving_proven_check.value: "domains"."state"::text not in ('active', 'drifted') or ("domains"."ownership_verified_at" is not null and "domains"."certificate_active_at" is not null and "domains"."activated_at" is not null and "domains"."edge_id" is not null)

project_invitations_accepted_or_revoked_.name: project_invitations_accepted_or_revoked_check
project_invitations_accepted_or_revoked_.value: not ("project_invitations"."accepted_at" is not null and "project_invitations"."revoked_at" is not null)
